sources.observations: Actual photograph inspected: long nearly parallel needle sides; narrow terminal; curved/drooping axes and different leaf inclinations within a shoot. Aggregated grouped surfaces and coverage are artistic simplifications, not copied geometry or measured botanical dimensions.

study_scope: Modern reference supports linear opposed needle ranks and a feather silhouette only. Low-poly surface grouping, two secondary fans, orientations and artistic scale are original representation choices. No named prehistoric reconstruction.
